item.title: Future Door County trails continue to take shape
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Door County residents will have two upcoming opportunities to weigh in on how they travel throughout the peninsula.

item.title: Gamblers’ Teddy-Bear-Toss Game Combines Hockey, History, and Heart
item.description: Adam Collins -- Saturday's contest at the Resch Center marks the Gamblers' annual Teddy Bear Toss, a long-running tradition that turns a night of hockey into a community-wide act of generosity.

item.title: Algoma looks to fill vacant alderperson seat Monday
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Algoma Common Council will become whole again Monday when it decides between three candidates for the seat vacated by Dawn Kidd in District 4.

item.title: Peninsula Pride Farms celebrates 10 years at annual meeting
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Ten years after three owners of some of Kewaunee County's largest farms acknowledged their role in the area's water pollution issues, dozens of farmers are still working to follow through on their promise to help provide solutions.

item.title: Wagner latest to join Door County sheriff’s race
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Former Denver police officer Randy Wagner is the latest candidate vying for voters' support in November in the race to become the next Door County sheriff.

item.title: Drug bust suspects due back in court in February
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Three people arrested on drug charges earlier this month will be back in court in early February.

item.title: Former Fire Chief Hecht receives final page
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Surrounded by friends, family, and brothers and sisters in emergency services, the watch of former Sister Bay/Liberty Grove Fire Chief Chris Hecht ended Friday in Ellison Bay.

item.title: Groundhog Day Celebrations Return to Door County
item.description: Adam Collins -- Groundhog Day will be marked with a mix of quirky tradition and educational programming across Door County.

item.title: Women’s Fund of Door County Awards $30,000 Grant to Boys & Girls Club Program
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Women's Fund of Door County has awarded a $30,000 Health Grant to the Boys & Girls Club of Door County to support a new proactive mental health initiative for local youth.

item.title: Miss Door County to be crowned Feb. 7
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- You are about a week away from learning who the next Miss Door County, Miss Door County Teen and Miss Cherryland will be at the Southern Door Auditorium.
